description: Where 2 to 8 people flying from different homes can meet cheapest: the places every home has a route into, each with a weekend whose cached round trips price everyone, each person's fare, the total, and meet_url — the group's page with all of it filled in. A place with a warning is a poor option: say why, and offer the better pick it names. Prices are one adult, economy, as seen on `seen` (or last checked on `checked` when a fare has none).

homes.description: 2 to 8 home airports or city codes, one per person, person 1 first (NYC covers JFK, LGA and EWR)

limit.description: how many places to return, 1 to 8; 5 when omitted

month.description: YYYY-MM: meet on a weekend in that month; the next eight weekends from two weeks out when omitted

nights.description: nights they stay, 1 to 14; 3 (Friday to Monday) when omitted

name: where_to_meet

fares.description: each person's cheapest round trip for these dates, in the order of homes

book_url.description: opens the seller's booking page for this fare

checked.description: the day we last checked this route — not the day the price was seen, which can be days earlier

departs.description: local departure time with the airport's offset

duration.description: flying time; on a return, both directions together

lands.description: local arrival time with the airport's offset

month.description: YYYY-MM, on a per-month row that has no single date

page_url.description: the route's page on a2bflight.com — give the user this link first

seen.description: the day this price was seen; absent when we know only the day we last checked it

stops.description: connections; on a return, both directions together

home_within_days.description: a fare below may fly home this many days either side of back

leave_from.description: the earliest day a fare below leaves; each lands by out

meet_url.description: the group's page with everyone, the place and the dates filled in — give the user this link

total.description: the round trips below added up, one adult each; absent when they are in different currencies

warning.description: why this place is a poor option, and the better pick in this list — tell the user both

title: Where to meet
